newsitem.title: UK: Babcock gets $70 mln contract in China.
newsitem.headline: Babcock gets $70 mln contract in China.

text.p: British engineering firm Babcock International Group Plc said on Monday a unit had been awarded a $70 million petrochemical plant contract in China.

The company said Babcock King-Wilkinson, part of its process division, received a contract for the installation of a paraxylene plant at the Sinopec Luoyang Petrochemical Co's facility at Luoyang in Henan Province.
The new plant will produce 160,000 tonnes of paraxylene per year for use in the manufacture of purified terephthalic acid (PTA) destined for polyester production.
The facility was due to be commissioned in the year 2000, Babcock said in a statement.
The contract will be financed by a loan from Export Import Bank of Japan.
